svg.title: Allineamenti · stessa composizione
svg.desc: Original educational diagram. Genuine glyph outlines shaped with HarfBuzz from DM Sans, SIL OFL 1.1. No font substitution, horizontal scaling or clipping. Only the explicitly labelled simulated italic applies a geometric shear. Source fonts, hashes, locations and text runs are recorded in manifest.json. External editorial caption and rights are not embedded.
